description: Fetch the curated agentic-web standards and adoption digest for a YYYY-MM-DD date (defaults to latest; omits historical stats by default). Returns the stored digest items and sources plus latest_date and days_old (whole UTC days behind the newest digest; 0 when this date is the latest). Pass list: true to return { latest, latest_date, days_old: null, count, digests, page }, or include_stats: true (or compact: false; include_stats takes precedence when both are set) to include historical panel stats when present. Use digest for narrative briefings; use changes for raw field-level diffs.

compact.description: true (default): omit historical stats block; pass false to include stats when include_stats is unset

include_stats.description: true: include historical stats block when present; false: omit stats (takes precedence over compact)

name: digest
title: Agentic web digest
